target.title: ci(deadcode): restore enforced unused-export ratchet
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The unused-export baseline claimed that new entries fail CI, but the dependency shard stopped invoking `deadcode:exports` in #105704. At the same time, Knip's test-support exclusions lived under `ignoreFiles`, which only suppresses unused-file findings; unused exports and types from those files still inflated the baseline.

Related: #105575, #105595.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Move test-support patterns to Knip's top-level `ignore`, while keeping production `live-*` files under `ignoreFiles` so their exports remain analyzed.
- Restore `deadcode:exports` in the dependency shard. Current targets must provide the script; historical targets run it when their checkout supports it and otherwise retain the legacy fallback.
- Add guard tests for the Knip option semantics and current/historical CI behavior.
- Refresh the baseline from 5,705 entries on the reviewed `main` to 5,652 exact entries. This is configuration-driven cleanup plus a small hand-reviewed residue, not a mechanical export burn-down.
- Preserve the shipped `packages/gateway-client` timeout export while removing its duplicate core re-export. Remove one obsolete session patch writer whose production callers had already migrated.
- Classify fresh concurrent-main residue: internalize or delete nine genuinely private/dead exports, retain seven intentional test hooks in the baseline, and remove four now-live stale rows.

## User Impact

No user-facing behavior change. CI now enforces that unused exports cannot grow silently, while intentional test and protocol surfaces remain intact.

## Evidence

- `pnpm deadcode:exports`: exact 5,652-entry match on Blacksmith Testbox `tidal-hermit-07f3` (`tbx_01kxchkkyghntvqvx07egqqqe3`).
- CI-failure reproduction: `deadcode:exports`, session-accessor boundary, production/test TypeScript, and full lint all passed on `tidal-hermit-07f3`; Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29217583339.
- Focused ratchet/gateway/session/plugin proof: 314 tests passed across six Vitest shards on `crimson-lobster-b31f`.
- Focused auth/config/gateway/restart/plugin residue proof: 126 tests passed across six Vitest shards on `swift-crayfish-a34a`.
- `pnpm build`: passed on Blacksmith Testbox `silver-shrimp-49a9`; Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29216453346.
- Broad `pnpm check:changed`: passed in Crabbox run `run_b800202102f3`.
- Fresh autoreview after the CI fixup: clean, no actionable findings (0.92 confidence).
- `git diff --check`: clean.
